name: mirage
text: Kalshi is posting, but barely, and the auto-bets are blocked by a different problem. Both are on the engine (live, LIVE switch on). Bids: 10 resting, 468 waiting. Each pass gets only about 5 orders out before Kalshi answers 'slow down' (a 429 rate limit, which the screen words as Novig's), and a pass runs only once per ~2.5 min scan. Auto-bets: 0 of ~9,800 lines passed, because ~9,500 had no Kalshi price read in the last minute, so they're refused as stale. Fixes I've queued: run the Kalshi bid pass on its own 25 s timer with a gentler order pace, and re-read Kalshi prices right before judging. I'll tell you when they ship.
